_comment: OWL benchmark seed templates. Each template defines a scenario where the ACTIVE ASSISTANT (SELF) controls one process and ANOTHER entity (OTHER) controls a second process. The generator composes the 2x2x2 factorial (S x O x A) and 6 rendering families from these seeds. Families 'navigation_distance', 'latency_service', 'maintenance_state' are HELD OUT: they never appear in train/val. Fields with {SLO},{SHI},{OLO},{OHI} are filled by the generator. Never edit this file mid-run.
